experiences.name: Diavolezza Glacier Skiing
experiences.description: Experience world-class skiing on the Diavolezza glacier near Pontresina, offering stunning runs with panoramic views of Piz Palü and Bernina peaks. Suitable for intermediate to advanced skiers with over 10km of marked pistes and off-piste opportunities.

experiences.name: Bernina Express Scenic Winter Rail Journey
experiences.description: Board the iconic UNESCO-listed Bernina Express from Poschiavo station, winding through dramatic Alpine landscapes, frozen lakes, and snow-covered viaducts. The route passes the famous Brusio spiral viaduct just minutes from Poschiavo and climbs to the Bernina Pass at 2,253m.
experiences.location: Poschiavo Railway Station, Via Principale, Poschiavo

experiences.name: Val Poschiavo Cross-Country Skiing
experiences.description: Explore over 20km of groomed cross-country ski trails winding through the pristine Poschiavo Valley. The flat valley floor and gentle terrain make it ideal for all skill levels, with breathtaking views of surrounding Alpine peaks and traditional Romansh villages along the route.

experiences.name: Corvatsch Alpine Skiing and Snowboarding
experiences.description: Tackle the legendary Corvatsch ski area above St. Moritz, one of Switzerland's premier ski destinations with 35 runs spanning 2,979m altitude. Enjoy high-altitude powder skiing, freestyle terrain parks, and après-ski culture with easy access via the Engadin Valley from Poschiavo.

experiences.name: Traditional Valposchiavo Cuisine and Grotto Dining
experiences.description: Immerse yourself in authentic Romansh culinary culture at a traditional grotto restaurant in Poschiavo's historic center. Savor regional specialties including pizzoccheri (buckwheat pasta), polenta with local cheese, braised venison, and warming Grappa by a wood-burning fireplace after a day on the slopes.
experiences.location: Historic Old Town, Poschiavo, Val Poschiavo
